source.title: Call for Applicants - WQAC Members (November 2019)
source.content:
The WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! Applications are open to everyone and community members not currently holding a WCA position are encouraged to apply.

**What does the WQAC do?**
The WQAC is responsible for developing and ensuring quality standards within the WCA. This includes producing educational material for the WCA Community and ensuring that Staff Members throughout the organization maintain the required skills for their positions. The WQAC will be highly involved in the work that WCA Delegates perform and will look into quality concerns in various communities. 

The official rights and duties of the WQAC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2019.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.4%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf).
<!-- break -->
**Applicants are expected to have:**
- Strong attention to detail and practical thinking
- Good knowledge of how competitions are organized and run.
- Collaboration skills and responsiveness
- Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until **December 31st, 2019, 23:59 UTC** to Daniel Vædele Egdal ([degdal@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:degdal@worldcubeassociation.org)).

**The application document must be in PDF format, and should include the following:**
- A brief personal introduction
- Summary of activities done within the WCA
- Motivation for applying to join the WQAC

Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of the application, and may later receive a request to be interviewed. Anyone with questions about applying can contact 
Daniel Vædele Egdal ([degdal@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:degdal@worldcubeassociation.org)).

After the application period, the WQAC Leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once applicants have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your interest in assisting the WQAC and the WCA!

translation.title: WCA 质量保证委员会招募成员（2019 年 11 月）
translation.content:
WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）正在招募新成员，一起完成委员会的工作！申请面向所有人开放，也欢迎目前未在 WCA 任职的社区成员申请。

**WQAC 负责什么？**

WQAC 负责制定并落实 WCA 内部的质量标准，包括为 WCA 社区编写教学材料，以及确保组织各岗位的工作人员保持履职所需的能力。WQAC 将深入参与与 WCA 代表工作有关的事务，并调查各地社区反映的质量问题。

WQAC 的正式权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2019.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.4%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf)。

**我们希望申请者具备：**

* 细心、务实的思考方式。
* 熟悉比赛的组织和运行。
* 良好的协作能力，并能及时回应。
* 能够讨论想法及其依据。

申请者可于即日起至 **2019 年 12 月 31 日 23:59 UTC**，将申请材料发送给 Daniel Vædele Egdal（[degdal@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:degdal@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，应包含：**

* 简短的自我介绍。
* 参与 WCA 工作的经历。
* 申请加入 WQAC 的原因。

申请者会收到确认收件的回复，之后可能收到面试邀请。如有申请方面的问题，可联系 Daniel Vædele Egdal（[degdal@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:degdal@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请期结束后，WQAC 负责人将进行选拔，待获选者接受职位后公布新成员。

感谢你愿意为 WQAC 和 WCA 出力！
